shortDescription: This module configures and manages Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) cloud account on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: accesskeyid
options.description: Specifies the public part of the Amazon S3 access key credential of the AWS user that the system use to access the cloud storage.

options.name: bucketprefix
options.description: Specifies the prefix for the bucket object. Applies, when I(state=present), to create an Amazon S3 account.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: downbandwidthmbits
options.description: Specifies the download bandwidth limit in megabits per second (Mbps). The value must be a number 1-10240.

options.name: encrypt
options.description: Specifies whether to encrypt the data in the cloud account. By default, encryption is enabled if encryption is enabled on the cluster unless I(encrypt=no) is specified. Valid when I(state=present) to create an Amazon S3 account.

options.name: ignorefailures
options.description: Specify to change the access key whether the new access key works or not. Valid when I(state=present) to update an existing Amazon S3 account. Parameter is allowed only when I(accesskeyid) and I(secretaccesskey) are entered.

options.name: importsystem
options.description: Specifies that the system's data be imported. Valid when I(state=present) to update an existing Amazon S3 account.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: mode
options.description: Specifies the new or modified cloud account mode. Valid when I(state=present) to update an existing Amazon S3 account.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of an Amazon S3 account.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name of an Amazon S3 account. Valid when I(state=present), to rename the existing Amazon S3 account.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: refresh
options.description: Specifies a refresh of the system import candidates. If the account is in import mode, this parameter specifies a refresh of the data available for import.

options.name: region
options.description: Specifies the AWS region to use to access the cloud account and store data.

options.name: resetusagehistory
options.description: Resets the usage history (to 0). Storage consumption that reflects the space that is consumed on the cloud account is cumulative, which means that it remains in the current day row (the 0th row). Valid when I(state=present) to update an existing Amazon S3 account.

options.name: secretaccesskey
options.description: Specifies the secret access key of an Amazon S3 cloud account.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates, updates (C(present)), or deletes (C(absent)) an Amazon S3 account.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: upbandwidthmbits
options.description: Specifies the upload bandwidth limit in megabits per second (Mbps). The value must be a number 1-10240.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.
